description: Use when the person wants to make a new list of things they recommend, such as books, places, restaurants, films, music, recipes, products, software or AI tools. Creates it private and returns the exact slug to reuse in add_item. Repeating the same request dedupes instead of creating another recent list.

category.description: Usually omit: Curated picks the category from the title and picks. Set it only when the person names one: Food & Drink, Travel, Books, Music, Movies & TV, Gear & Tools, Software, Fashion, Home & Garden, Ideas & Essays, Art, or Spirituality.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Reusing it with identical input replays the first result.

subtitle.description: One-line description of what the list is and who it's for.

name: create_list
title: Create a private list
